dataset.name: UNT Computer Science Short Answer Dataset v2.0 (Mohler et al., 2011)

pipeline_configuration.representation: HybridProposition (RobustProposition: S-P-O triples, non-finite clausal fragments, modifiers, prepositional arguments)
pipeline_configuration.semantic_matcher: SemanticMatcherV2 (multi-tier: exact, lemma, WordNet derivation, domain equivalences)
pipeline_configuration.matching_strategy: Hungarian bipartite global matching with predicate-gated cross-slot matching
pipeline_configuration.contradiction_detector: PropertyContradictionDetector (conservative, incompatible property value sets, antonym resolution, explicit negation)
pipeline_configuration.classifier: RobustAdditionalInfoClassifier (4-step epistemic classification: CORRECT_ADDITIONAL, IRRELEVANT, UNCERTAIN, INCORRECT)

scorer_configuration.model_name: SeverityAwareScorer (Model D Core/Additional Decomposition with Gated Compensation)

formula.gated_positive_bonus: pos_adj = min(M_pos * (r * n_correct / (1 + r * n_correct)), 0.50 * S_core_effective)
formula.minor_penalties: minor_pen = sum(minor_penalty_weight * severity_i for severity_i < sigma_core_threshold)
